en.headline: Tsim Sha Tsui bar assault victim dies, police reclassify case as murder
en.dek: A 32-year-old man died early on Friday after the 26 July attack at an upstairs bar; police have reclassified the case as murder, made two further arrests and will charge one man with murder.
body: The 32-year-old man who was attacked at an upstairs bar in Tsim Sha Tsui on 26 July died in the early hours of Friday, police said. Officers have reclassified the case from wounding with intent to murder.

Police said the man, who had remained in critical condition in intensive care at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after two brain operations, died at about 2.54 am. He had suffered serious head injuries and a rib fracture in the attack, which lasted about half a minute and involved seven to eight people, some of whom are believed to have triad backgrounds.

Two further men, aged 29 and 30 and described as non-ethnic Chinese, were arrested on suspicion of wounding, bringing the total number of people arrested to nine. A 33-year-old man will be provisionally charged with murder and a 37-year-old man with assisting an offender. The cases were due to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Friday afternoon.

The original incident occurred shortly after midnight on 26 July at a bar in the Golden Building commercial centre on Cameron Road. Police said the victim had been attending a birthday gathering when a dispute arose with people at a neighbouring table.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧傷人案受害人不治 警方改列謀殺案
zh.dek: 32歲男子於7月26日在尖沙咀樓上酒吧遇襲後，今晨不治；警方將案件改列謀殺，再拘兩人，其中一人將被控謀殺罪。
body: 警方表示，7月26日在尖沙咀一間樓上酒吧遇襲的32歲男子，今晨傷重不治，案件已由有意圖傷人改列為謀殺。
事主一直在伊利沙伯醫院深切治療部留醫，曾接受兩次腦部手術，情況危殆，延至今日凌晨約2時54分不治。他頭部重創及肋骨骨折，襲擊歷時約半分鐘，涉及七至八人，部分人相信有黑社會背景。
警方再拘捕兩名分別29歲及30歲的非華裔男子，涉嫌傷人，至今共九人被捕。其中一名33歲男子將被改暫控一項謀殺罪，另一名37歲男子已被暫控協助罪犯，案件今日下午在九龍城裁判法院提堂。
事發於尖沙咀金馬倫道金壘商業中心一間樓上酒吧，事主當時參加生日派對，疑與鄰檯人士發生爭執後遭圍毆。
